title: Role Anatomy and Galaxy Dependencies
objective: Design configurable roles and manage reviewed dependencies.

sourceAlignment.title: Ansible for DevOps, 2nd Edition
sourceAlignment.author: Jeff Geerling
sourceAlignment.note: Original Code Forge companion material; no book prose is reproduced.

paragraphs: Roles conventionally contain tasks, handlers, defaults, vars, files, templates, metadata, and tests. Public settings belong in defaults; role vars are difficult for consumers to override.
Galaxy distributes roles and collections. Pin dependencies in requirements files, install them inside the project, inspect their source and maintenance, and record licenses.
explanation.rule: Operational rule: Design configurable roles and manage reviewed dependencies.

examples.title: Working design artifact
examples.code:
role_policy:
  public_configuration: defaults
  notifications: handlers
  rendered_files: templates
  dependencies: requirements.yml
  versions_pinned: true
examples.note: Use this as a reasoning model before applying changes to the disposable lab.
